# Faith Meredith

## Overview

- **Age:** 11 years old  <sub>[v5 c2 P29](../source/v05-c02.md#nw-v05-c02-p0029)</sub>
- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v5 c2 P29](../source/v05-c02.md#nw-v05-c02-p0029), [v5 c5 P1](../source/v05-c05.md#nw-v05-c05-p0001)</sub>
- **Origin:** Maywater  <sub>[v5 c4 P46](../source/v05-c04.md#nw-v05-c04-p0046)</sub>
- **Role:** Schoolgirl  <sub>[v5 c5 P3](../source/v05-c05.md#nw-v05-c05-p0003), [v5 c10 P39](../source/v05-c10.md#nw-v05-c10-p0039)</sub>
- **Nicknames:** Red Rose  <sub>[v5 c16 P65](../source/v05-c16.md#nw-v05-c16-p0065)</sub>

## Appearance

Faith is described as a beauty with long curls and a picture-like, pretty appearance. When sleeping, she looks rosy and beautiful.

_Sources: [v5 c2 P29](../source/v05-c02.md#nw-v05-c02-p0029), [v5 c9 P86](../source/v05-c09.md#nw-v05-c09-p0086), [v5 c21 P6](../source/v05-c21.md#nw-v05-c21-p0006), [v5 c26 P22](../source/v05-c26.md#nw-v05-c26-p0022)_

## Personality

Faith is a lively tomboy full of spirit, humor, and impulsive energy. She is heedless and fearless, acting on impulse and often initiating playful or bold schemes without thinking through the consequences. Despite her frequent scrapes and misadventures, she is deeply loyal, loving, and protective of her family and friends. She strongly resents being insulted or insulted on behalf of her loved ones, yet holds no malice and is universally loved for her warmth and joyful spirit.

_Sources: [v5 c2 P29](../source/v05-c02.md#nw-v05-c02-p0029), [v5 c5 P0](../source/v05-c05.md#nw-v05-c05-p0000), [v5 c12 P28](../source/v05-c12.md#nw-v05-c12-p0028), [v5 c16 P0](../source/v05-c16.md#nw-v05-c16-p0000), [v5 c16 P24](../source/v05-c16.md#nw-v05-c16-p0024), [v5 c16 P26](../source/v05-c16.md#nw-v05-c16-p0026), [v5 c23 P46](../source/v05-c23.md#nw-v05-c23-p0046), [v5 c26 P19](../source/v05-c26.md#nw-v05-c26-p0019), [v5 c26 P22](../source/v05-c26.md#nw-v05-c26-p0022)_

- To reform and avoid bringing scandal upon the manse  <sub>[v5 c23 P54](../source/v05-c23.md#nw-v05-c23-p0054), [v5 c24 P0](../source/v05-c24.md#nw-v05-c24-p0000)</sub>

## History

After moving to the manse in Glen St. Mary, Faith quickly bonded with the Blythe children in Rainbow Valley. Operating without strict parental supervision due to her father's abstracted nature and Aunt Martha's incompetence, Faith frequently got involved in innocent escapades that scandalized local gossips, such as dancing on tombstones or accidentally cleaning house on Sunday due to a mix-up in days. To clear her father of blame for the Sunday house-cleaning rumour, she boldly addressed the entire congregation during a church service. Soon after, she dared Walter Blythe to ride pigs through the village streets, further shocking the community. Hearing that Norman Douglas's absence from church was causing her father trouble, Faith visited him directly and persuaded him to attend services monthly. When her pet rooster Adam was killed by Aunt Martha to feed a visiting minister, Mr. Perry, Faith was devastated, but she retaliated by singeing the minister's coat-tail when he criticized her upbringing. Seeking comfort, she struck up a deep friendship with Rosemary West. After realizing how much trouble their heedless actions caused their father, Faith helped establish the Good-Conduct Club to discipline themselves. However, her impulsive generosity—giving her shoes and stockings to a poor girl—led to her attending Sunday School bare-legged, which caused another parish scandal. To defend her father, Faith published a candid letter in the local newspaper explaining the incident.
